description:
Reid Hype | Jump Mountain bike
Compact, agile and built for action – the ideal dirt jump mountain bike for tackling pump tracks, hitting jumps and developing your skills at the local skatepark.
The Reid Hype is designed for riders who want a mountain bike that delivers responsive handling and dependable performance for aggressive riding. While modern mountain bikes are often built around larger frames and wheels, the Hype offers a compact, low-slung design that makes it easier to manoeuvre through tight turns, launch off jumps and enjoy freestyle riding.
Its compact geometry helps create a nimble, responsive feel, giving you the control needed to navigate technical features and progress your riding skills. Whether you're flowing through pump tracks, hitting dirt jumps or practising tricks at the skatepark, the Hype is built to keep up with your riding ambitions.
Designed with manoeuvrability and durability in mind, the Hype provides a capable platform for riders who enjoy pushing their limits. Its compact proportions make it easier to move the bike through turns, lift off jumps and adjust your position in the air, while its robust design suits the demands of repeated jumps and aggressive riding.
Whether you're an aspiring slopestyle rider or simply looking for a fun, agile mountain bike for your local trails and skatepark, the Reid Hype offers an exciting way to build confidence, develop your technique and enjoy a more playful style of riding.
The Hype is ideal for:

Dirt jumping, with a compact design suited to launching off jumps and developing aerial skills

Pump track riding, with agile handling for flowing through berms, rollers and tight turns

Skatepark riding, offering a manoeuvrable mountain bike for practising tricks and improving freestyle skills

Aspiring slopestyle riders, looking for a responsive bike to help build confidence and progress their riding

Technical trails and tight turns, with a compact, low-slung design that helps keep the bike nimble and controlled

Aggressive mountain biking, with a robust construction suited to the demands of jumps and more dynamic riding

Riders seeking a more playful mountain bike, offering a compact alternative to larger, trail-focused MTB designs

Riders developing their skills, with a fun, agile bike suited to learning new techniques and progressing at their own pace
